description: We are BrydanWorld, a young and curious team led by 9-year-old Nivaan from India. We love space exploration, robotics, coding, and creative problem-solving. With experience in Scratch, Python, and beginner electronics projects, we aim to make space science fun through interactive games and simulations. Our mission is to learn, experiment, and build something meaningful for the NASA Space Apps Challenge. We welcome creative minds interested in space, science, game design, and coding!
